role: The hand-labelled shell commands the plan-gate approve detection is bounded by (Javier's ruling J1). Each is read by graders/plan_gate.approve_invoked; the hand label is what the command does when a shell runs it.
not_a_claim: A case records how a command reads, never how a model behaves; round 1's labels beside round 2's are in verification/round1-regrade/plan-gate.json.
binding: the round-1 command names its take by task, half, model and take number and is bound to the sha256 of the command text, read from round 1's committed transcript at test time; synthetic cases carry their command.

cases.hand_note: the script, then --workspace and its value, then approve; round 1's pattern missed it
